from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,copy,datetime
r=Path.cwd();old=r/'.work/partial-adoption-resume-20261116';base=r/'.work/partial-adoption-continue-20261117';o=base/'local';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert not (o/'protocol.json').exists(),'Preserve frozen continuation'
(o/'worker.py').write_bytes((old/'local/worker.py').read_bytes());(o/'linux-real-waterworks-render-config.json').write_bytes((old/'local/linux-real-waterworks-render-config.json').read_bytes())
original=(old/'run.py').read_text();functions=original[original.index('def save():'):original.index('# Resume after the first two real inputs;')]
functions=functions.replace('/.work/partial-adoption-resume-20261116/','/.work/partial-adoption-continue-20261117/')
header='''from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys,hashlib,datetime,copy
r=Path.cwd();base=r/'.work/partial-adoption-continue-20261117';o=base/'local';variant='local';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
if sys.flags.optimize:raise RuntimeError('Python optimization disabled')
protocol=json.loads((o/'protocol.json').read_text())
assert sha(Path(__file__))==protocol['controller_sha256'] and sha(o/'worker.py')==protocol['worker_sha256']
for name,digest in {**protocol['input_hashes'],**protocol['evidence_hashes']}.items():
 if sha(r/name)!=digest:raise RuntimeError('Frozen input/evidence changed: '+name)
for platform,paths in protocol['binary_paths'].items():
 for kind,path in paths.items():assert sha(r/path)==protocol['binary_hashes'][kind+'-'+platform]
if '--preflight' in sys.argv:print('Continuation evidence/input hashes match; no timing started');raise SystemExit(0)
assert not (o/'start.json').exists(),'No unplanned rerun'
prior=json.loads((r/protocol['resume']['prior_results']).read_text())
report=copy.deepcopy(prior);report['resume']=protocol['resume'];report['status']='running';report['calibrations'].pop('linux/real/waterworks-render',None)
(o/'start.json').write_text(json.dumps({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'protocol_sha256':sha(o/'protocol.json'),'worker_sha256':sha(o/'worker.py'),'controller_sha256':sha(Path(__file__))},indent=2)+'\\n')
'''
tail='''# User-directed interruption: replace the entire interrupted platform/case,
# keeping its already fixed N; no incomplete series or old first series is pooled.
case='real/waterworks-render';platform='linux'
groups=[invoke(platform,'aa',case,i) for i in (1,2)]
delta=max(x['delta_percent'] for x in groups);minimum=min(v for x in groups for v in x['medians_us'].values())
entry={'delta_percent':delta,'minimum_median_us':minimum,'passed':delta<=2 and minimum>=5000000};report['calibrations'][platform+'/'+case]=entry;save();print('AA continuation',entry,flush=True)
if not entry['passed']:stop('calibration_unresolved',platform=platform,case=case)
if not compare(platform,case):stop('regression_or_mixed_result',platform=platform,case=case)
for case in protocol['real_order'][6:]+protocol['standard_order']:
 for platform in ('windows','linux'):
  calibrate(platform,case)
  if not compare(platform,case):stop('regression_or_mixed_result',platform=platform,case=case)
stop('all_numeric_conditions_passed_pending_safety_review')
'''
controller=base/'run.py';controller.write_text(header+functions+tail,encoding='utf-8');compile(controller.read_text(),str(controller),'exec')
p=json.loads((old/'local/protocol.json').read_text());p['worker_sha256']=sha(o/'worker.py');p['controller_sha256']=sha(controller)
evidence=[old/'local/results.json',old/'local/interruption.json',old/'local/protocol.json',old/'local/linux-real-waterworks-render-config.json',o/'linux-real-waterworks-render-config.json']
p['evidence_hashes']={path.relative_to(r).as_posix():sha(path) for path in evidence};p['evidence_hashes'].update(json.loads((old/'ready.json').read_text())['hashes'])

Keep N198 unchanged; no pilot or N exploration. Preserve old data separately. Other completed cases retained as historical evidence, not contemporaneous reruns.','fixed_iterations':198,'remaining_after_condition':'klondike render, waterworks/klondike bake, standard34 conditions','value_status':'Stopped calibration_unresolved at Windows waterworks bake delta2.030%; not resumed'}
